title: Alcazar of Sevilla is a must if you visit Sevilla.
text: Alcazar de Sevilla skip the line tour was perfect for us since we didn’t have much time left regarding our busy schedule. Tourist guide was nice and knowledgeable. Palace was amazing.and we were excited to see why Game of thrones was filmed there. We recommend this tour without a doubt.
author: E5314KWdeborahp

title: Excellent Guided Tour of the Alcázar of Seville
text: I highly recommend the guided tour of the Alcázar of Seville. It was a very enjoyable and interesting experience, and our guide was kind, professional, and very knowledgeable. The tour made the visit much more engaging and helped us appreciate the history and beauty of the palace even more.
author: Shoham101

title: Great Personal Tour!
text: Great personalized tour! This was a small tour with just my wife and I and the tour guide. We had a great time! Our tour guide was extremely engaging and made it a point to make the tour personal. He was extremely patient and explained so much about the Alcazar and the history of Spain. It brought back a lot of memories of school lessons about the Spanish Empire. Being there made the experience that much better. The tour group did a great job communicating where/when to start. I highly recommend them for this tour if you are looking for a personal tour experience.
author: C3777IJjoel

title: Total immersion in the Alcazar
text: What a great experience!! Our guide Carlos was simply the best. Very knowledgeable and passionate about history, it really immersed us with his explanations and comments. Very straight to the point which I loved because there was no second wasted. If we had visited the Alcazar without his guidance it would have been a completely different experience - beautiful, because the Alcazar is ASTOUNDING, but empty and shallow…
